summary: Verified logo/name mapping fix and Supabase Postgres swap. All 5 clubs returned by GET /api/clubs in expected slot order [gfg-kare, acm-kare, ieee-eds, acm-w-kare, gdg-kare] with correct logo asset ids (kwb4jxde, 8f6z2auc, zaogaxa6, qop5o1eu, oje6iuak). displayOrder is 1..5. No stale 'partner-05' slug remains. Postgres end-to-end confirmed: DATABASE_URL uses postgresql+asyncpg (Supabase transaction pooler), /api/health returns 200, admin@euphoria.dev/Admin@12345 login returns access_token, admin statistics reachable, registration create returns EUH26-XXXXXX, duplicate team_name returns 409 TEAM_NAME_ALREADY_EXISTS (Postgres unique index works), public GET /api/registrations/{id} returns non-PII payload, /api/uploads/id-proof and /api/admin/branding/club-logo/gdg-kare uploads succeed. 21/21 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: No admin endpoint exists to reset a club's logoUrl back to the original seed value; branding/club-logo/{slug} only replaces with an uploaded file. Consider adding a reset-to-seed endpoint for admin recovery.

Registration schema requires member_number==1 to submit id_proof (TEAM_LEAD_ID_PROOF_REQUIRED). The error surfaces as pydantic 422 with nested msg — clients should read ctx to distinguish this from generic validation. Consider raising HTTPException with structured detail.code for consistency with other errors.
